label: manifold
definition: A smooth n-dimensional manifold M is a second-countable Hausdorff topological space equipped with a maximal smooth atlas of charts.

label: tangent space
definition: The tangent space T_p M at a point p in M is the vector space of all tangent vectors (derivations) at p.

label: riemannian metric
definition: A Riemannian metric g on M is a smooth assignment of a positive-definite inner product g_p on each tangent space T_p M.

label: levi civita
definition: The Levi-Civita connection \nabla is the unique torsion-free, metric-compatible affine connection on the Riemannian manifold (M,g).

label: partition of unity
definition: Given any open cover of M, there exists a smooth partition of unity subordinate to it.

label: covariant derivative
definition: The covariant derivative \nabla_X Y is tensorial (linear over C^\infty(M)) in X and satisfies the Leibniz rule in Y.

label: riemann curvature
definition: The Riemann curvature tensor R measures the failure of iterated second covariant derivatives to commute; it is a (1,3)-tensor.

label: gauss bonnet
definition: For a closed orientable surface M, the integral of Gaussian curvature K over M equals 2\pi times its Euler characteristic \chi(M).
